sources.title: aisingapore/Gemma-SEA-LION-v4-27B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Details Model Description SEA-LION stands for Southeast Asian Languages In One Network. We performed continued pre-training in English and SEA languages on Gemma 3 27B IT, a decoder model using the Gemma 3 architecture, to create Gemma-SEA-LION-v4-27B. For tokenization, the model employs the default tokenizer used in Gemma 3 27B IT.
